title: dalbergia negrensis
intro: Dalbergia negrensis, commonly known as the Brazilian rosewood, is a plant species belonging to the family Fabaceae. The health benefits of Dalbergia negrensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, pain, and infections. Its therapeutic actions include acting as a diuretic and astringent, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as diarrhea, dysentery, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Dalbergia negrensis include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
